column1: # check_test_branch_conditions's programs (c_check_branch_condition_test.c; #2883): ID, FILE, FLAGS, NAME, tab-separated.
# Each runs natively against clang's build of it; its NAME selects the checks of its entries.
# Conditions whose `&&`, `||` and `!` are written as branches, first in the unit, their entries checked: no join and one test a branch; then the values that keep their joins.

# The order and the effects of the operands: calls that trace what they evaluate, nested three deep and more, in every statement's condition, a conditional's and a statement expression's, of every scalar type.
